response.original_title: There Is Ringing Inside, It Is Evening
response.overview: A collection of solo and collaborative performances which were projected, looped and accompanied by the live score of an audio installation in solo exhibition 'There is Ringing Inside, It is Evening.' These short performances address the loss of the filmmaker's partner and an attempt to connect with his absent figure through interactions with vacancies in the frame and ritual bells - a reference to Bell, his middle name.
